measure.name: add_horizontal_trench_ground_loop
measure.description: Creates a ground loop for a water-source heat pump: a condenser loop with a constant-speed pump and a horizontal trench ground heat exchanger in soil described by its thermal properties and a Kusuda-Achenbach undisturbed ground temperature model, filled with water or propylene glycol. The selected heat pump's source side is connected to the loop. Supports plant loop EIR and water-to-water equation fit heat pumps, heating or cooling, whose source side is not yet on a loop. Use it after a measure that creates the heat pump, such as Create Water-to-Water Heat Pump.
measure.modeler_description: Creates a PlantLoop (condenser sizing) with PumpConstantSpeed (Intermittent, end use subcategory 'Ground Loop Pumps') at the supply inlet, a GroundHeatExchangerHorizontalTrench on a supply branch, and a SetpointManagerScheduled at the supply outlet. The trench is not controlled, so the setpoint is passive; it is also the sizing exit temperature (3 C design temperature difference). The GHX and pump use one design flow: entered, or the heat pump's hard-sized source side flow. The GHX soil properties also feed a new SiteGroundTemperatureUndisturbedKusudaAchenbach, which replaces the GHX's default ground model. Pipe properties are HDPE (0.39 W/m-K, 950 kg/m3, 1900 J/kg-K). The heat pump is added to the loop's demand side with addDemandBranchForComponent. HeatPumpPlantLoopEIRHeating/Cooling show CondenserType AirSource until connected to a source loop. 'First water-source heat pump' takes EIR heat pumps tagged with AdditionalProperties IntendedCondenserType = WaterSource (as Create Water-to-Water Heat Pump does) and equation fit heat pumps. Untagged EIR heat pumps can be picked by name and are converted to water source.

argument.name: hp_name
argument.description: Heat pump whose source side is connected to the new ground loop. 'First water-source heat pump without a source loop' takes the first one found when the measure runs, for use after a measure in the same workflow that creates the heat pump.
argument.default_value: First water-source heat pump without a source loop

choice.value: First water-source heat pump without a source loop
choice.display_name: First water-source heat pump without a source loop

argument.name: loop_name
argument.description: Name of the new condenser loop. Must not match an existing plant loop.

argument.name: design_flow_gpm
argument.description: Design flow of the ground heat exchanger and pump, gpm. 0 uses the heat pump's source side flow, which must then be hard-sized.

argument.name: glycol_pct
argument.description: Propylene glycol concentration in the ground loop, percent. 0 = plain water.

argument.name: loop_setpoint_f
argument.display_name: Loop setpoint and sizing exit temperature (F)
argument.description: The ground heat exchanger is not controlled, so this setpoint is passive; it is also the loop's design exit temperature for sizing, deg F.

argument.name: pump_hp
argument.description: Ground loop pump electric input at design flow, hp. The pump runs at constant speed whenever the heat pump runs.

argument.name: n_trenches
argument.description: Number of parallel horizontal trenches, one pipe each.

argument.name: trench_length_ft
argument.description: Pipe length per trench, ft.

argument.name: trench_spacing_ft
argument.description: Center-to-center horizontal spacing between trench pipes, ft.

argument.name: burial_depth_ft
argument.description: Depth of the pipes below grade, ft.

argument.name: pipe_od_in
argument.description: HDPE pipe outside diameter, inches. Default: 1-1/4 in. SDR 11.

argument.name: pipe_id_in
argument.description: HDPE pipe inside diameter, inches. Default: 1-1/4 in. SDR 11.

argument.name: soil_k
argument.description: Soil thermal conductivity, Btu/h-ft-F. Default: moist silt loam (1.2 W/m-K).

argument.name: soil_density
argument.description: Soil density, lb/ft3. Default: silt loam (1,700 kg/m3).

argument.name: soil_cp
argument.description: Soil specific heat, Btu/lb-F. Default: moist silt loam (1,400 J/kg-K).

argument.name: soil_moisture_pct
argument.description: Volumetric soil moisture content, percent.

argument.name: soil_moisture_sat_pct
argument.description: Volumetric soil moisture content at saturation, percent.

argument.name: ground_avg_f
argument.description: Annual average ground surface temperature for the Kusuda-Achenbach model, deg F. The mean annual air temperature is a common estimate.

argument.name: ground_amp_f
argument.description: Amplitude of the annual ground surface temperature swing, deg F (half the difference between the warmest and coldest monthly means).

argument.name: ground_phase_days
argument.display_name: Day of minimum ground surface temperature
argument.description: Day of the year on which the ground surface temperature is lowest.
